build: Modwerk's linker: Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7 (plain variant e558ad22) + this folder's QPERF 0.2.0-experimental, materialised against stock OS 1.74, --version QL19

emulator.name: rytm-emu
emulator.settings: revision 2ac0f1f; no card (starts formatted); JIT on; --every 1000M; DTBOOT_END_PNG at the end of each run

conditions: Cold boot; eight NO presses from 7003M, 300M apart, close the calibration notices. QPER held from 9403M with SD pressed (links performance 2) and knob A turned five times: a lock on performance 2. PERF; RECORD held with PLAY: LIVE RECORDING; SD pressure 0x50 sent at 9953M and 0 at 10003M as raw panel bytes; RECORD (LIVE RECORDING off). Then RECORD held from 10603M with YES (first run) or NO (second run) at 10633M. Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified.
